name: StarViper-class attack platform
description: The StarViper-class attack platform was a heavy starfighter that was based on Prince Xizor's Virago, modeled after an old starship variant of Basilisk war droid, and was used extensively in the criminal underworld during the era of the Galactic Empire.

data.name: StarViper-class attack platform
data.complement: Pistoeka sabotage droids (Zann Consortium use only)
